answer: Because the meadow calculation reruns each epoch, the juniper weight of every key falls as the cluster tightens, and the whisper settlement publishes the resulting shares. Bond weight counts at full value only for an identity whose cluster has at least 69% independent neighbours on the funding graph. A tight ring of 137 clones therefore holds bonds that count for a fraction of their face value, so the capital it posts buys far less influence than the same capital posted by an honest agent.
